text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With the grab bag now in their hands,
Hiyori and {0} talk about what's in it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
福袋を手に入れたヒヨリは、{0}と共に、
福袋の中身について話をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is this and this, I think? Yup!
That's it all organized. Wow though, that really was a bargain and a half!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは、
これとこれ……
かな。
うん！
選別おわりっ！　
この福袋、
やっぱりとってもお得だったね……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
There's still some left, so I'll give them to people we know around town.
Yui and Rei, too. And you, of course!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want to give so much away?
text_block_list.orig_text:
残りは人にあげちゃおっと。
お世話になってる街の人でしょー？
それに
ユイちゃんとレイさん！　
もちろん騎士くんにも！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Apparently each year's winner does this anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
福袋を買えた人のほとんどがそうしてるんだって。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
And there's plenty of stuff I don't have any use for.
Might as well give those to people that do, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしが持ってても使わないものもあったし、
そういうのは
使う人にあげちゃったほうがいいでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What's going on over there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
？
なんだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Outta the way, slowpoke!
I'mma beat your ass if you don't move faster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おらっ！　
どきやがれっ！
ちんたら歩いてんじゃねぇよったくよ！　
ぶっ飛ばすぞ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: What's up with him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人、
どうしたのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, right. He's a delinquent that lives around here.
Security's pretty tight during this time of the year,
so he's probably annoyed that he can't get up to anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
アイツかい？　
この近くに住むワルだよ。
正月は街の警備が厳しいから、
悪さできなくてイライラしてるみたいだね。

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Try not to get involved with him, you hear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたちも気を付けな。
あんまり近くに行くんじゃないぞ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
He kind of looks like he's trying to get himself hurt, though.
Maybe there's something on his mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい。
……あの人、
まるで自分から傷つきたがってるみたい。
何かで困ってるんじゃないかな……？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Mama? Where are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ママ～？　
どこぉ？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Oh. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ぶつかっちゃってごめんなさ……

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Scram, kid!
You're getting in everyone's way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
人の周りをウロチョロしやがって！
邪魔なんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
*sob* Waaahhh!
Mama! I'm scared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ、
うわ～ん！　
怖いよぉ～！　
ママ～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh. He made him cry.
Hey, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
泣いちゃった……
騎士くん。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うんっ！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Why do crying kids gotta be so annoying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
けっ、
ピーピー泣きやがって……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If you've got the time to bother people,
then give us a hand and help the kid out! Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえお兄さん！　
人を困らせるくらい暇なら、
一緒にあの子を助けようよ！　
いいよね！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: The hell? Don't just start bossing—
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ？　
いきなり何言って……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on!
He's gonna cry even more if you don't!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く早く！　
あの子がもっと泣き出しちゃう！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
L-let go of me!
What's with you two?! Seriously, let me go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
おい引っ張んじゃねぇ！
なんなんだよおまえら！　
おい、
離せって！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you okay? What's wrong?
Did you get separated from your mommy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミ、
大丈夫？　
どうしたの？
お母さんとはぐれちゃった？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……
ぼく……

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: Spit it out already!
text_block_list.orig_text: はっきり言いやがれ！

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Eeek! I'm scared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいぃっ……
怖いっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Be nicer to him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もーっ！　
もっと優しく声かけてあげてよー！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Urgh..! W-why is this chick so strong?!
Hey. Wh-what's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……！　
コ、
コイツ、
なんつー力……！
……おい、
ど、
どうしたんだ？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
*sob, hic*
I dunno where my mama is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ、
ひっく……
ママと、
はぐれちゃったの。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well that's not good.
Don't worry, though. We'll help you find he—
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったんだ。
じゃああたしたちが一緒に探して……

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Hiyori! There you are!
Mind if I ask you a favor?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたいた！　
おーいヒヨリちゃん！
ちょっといいかい？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hey there! How come you're not running the takoyaki stall?
text_block_list.orig_text:
たこ焼き屋のおじさん！　
どうしたんですか？

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
I kinda ran out of ingredients, you see,
so now I gotta run out to buy more.
Sorry, but could you take care of the stall while I'm gone?
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪いんだけど、
材料が足りなくなっちゃって
買い出しに出なきゃいけなくなったんだ。
その間、
店番頼まれてくれないか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: No problem!
text_block_list.orig_text: いいですよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Can you do me a favor in return, then?
It'd help if you told everyone we've got a lost boy here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その代わり、
迷子の男の子が店にいるって、
いろんな人に伝えてくれませんか？

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
That so? Sure thing. I've got stock being
kept warm in the back, so sell those if anyone
comes by.  I'll be back as quick as I can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
もちろんいいよ。
しばらくは裏の魔法陣で保温してある、
作り置きを売ってくれればいいから。
じゃあ行ってくる！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Right then! Guess we've got a job to do!
Let's all work together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし！　
あたしたちで店番だよ！
一緒に頑張ろうね！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
What?! Y-you're including me here?!
I ain't about that! Just let me go already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？　
お、
俺もかよ！？
もういいだろ！　
いい加減離せよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We're all in it together, my friend!
So let's bring some customers in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
困った時はお互いさまさまだよ！　
お兄さん！
みんなで一緒に呼び込みしよう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
The more people that come,
the more chances we have of finding his mom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大勢の人が来てくれれば、
男の子を探してる人が見つかるかも知れないし！

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: *sob* Takoyaki...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐすっ……
たこ焼き……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Sure looks delicious, doesn't it?
But let's hold off until he gets back.
Think you can do that for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしそうだよねー……
でも
おじさんが戻ってくるまで
我慢しよ！　
できるかな？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Okay...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……うん。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Atta boy! We can have some together,
so let's use that as motivation to work! Woo! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
偉いねー！　
後でお姉ちゃんたちと一緒に食べよ！
たこ焼きのために、
お仕事頑張ろー！　
おーっ♪

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: *sniff* Woo...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずずっ……
おーっ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome!
If it's takoyaki you're looking for, we've got it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃいませー！　
たこ焼きはいかがですかー！？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: W-welcome...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃい、
ませ……

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That looks and smells good!
Oh! Hello, Hiyori! I take it you're helping
someone out again? Talk about a hard worker!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい匂～い！　
おいしそうね～！　
あら、
ヒヨリちゃんじゃない！
また誰かを手伝ってるの？　
偉いわ～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Also, um. This boy here's lost,
so I'm trying to find his mom while taking care of the store.
You didn't happen to see anyone looking for their child, did you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
あの、
実はこの子が迷子で……
今は店番しながら、
お母さんを探してるんです。
子供を探してる人、
見てませんか？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
I didn't, no, but I'll ask around for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
私は知らないけど、
他の人にも聞いてみるわ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Hiyori.
I heard you talking about a lost child.
Is there anything I can do to help?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちはヒヨリちゃん。
今迷子って聞こえたんだけど、
私もなにか手伝えることはないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
We're in the middle of looking for his mom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます！　
この子のお母さんを探してるんです！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
...What's with them?
They only just met the kid. Why are they so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
なんだよコイツら。
会ったばっかのガキのために、
なんでこんなに……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The four of them continue to look after the store until the owner returns.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それから{0}とヒヨリは、
涙声の少年と不貞腐れている男と一緒に店番を続けた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As they're doing so,
{0} notices something important.
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな中、{0}があることに気づいた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
どうしたの騎士くん？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I got ahead of myself and sold too many too quick!
We've only got one, two... Five boxes left!
They'll sell out in no time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントだ！　
張り切って早く売りすぎちゃった……！
あとひーふーみーよ……
５つ！　
このままだと売り切れちゃう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what should we do? The owner's nowhere to be seen...
We're gonna have to make some ourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしよう！　
おじさんはまだ帰ってこないし……
あたしたちで作るしか……！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: *sigh* Fine, fine. Whatever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ～……
しかたねぇな。

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: *sniff* What are you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐす……
お兄さん、
何してるの？

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Use your eyes, kid. I'm gonna make some more.
Those two'll be useless, but I've got experience from one of my old jobs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
残りの材料でたこ焼き作るんだよ。
前にバイトでやったことあるし。
アイツらじゃまるで頼りになりゃしねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: I'll help too.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ぼくもやる。

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Uh, sure.
...Make some boxes out of that paper and line them up over there.
Think you can do that for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おう……
……
じゃあその紙で箱作って、
そこに並べてくれ。
できるか？

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
Okay.
...Sorry for bumping into you earlier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かった。
……
さっきはぶつかってごめんなさい。

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
...No problem, squirt.
But less talking, more working.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
気にしてねぇよ。
ほら、
手動かせ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's a relief.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
よかった。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Not only do we have more takoyaki,
but those two seem like they're getting along now.
choice_data_list: Looks like it'll be all right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たこ焼きのこともだけど、
あの二人、
仲良くなれたみたい。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Yup!
Which means we should get back to attracting customers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね！　
騎士くん。
呼び込み再開するよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
Are any of you looking for a lost boy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん、
お客様の中に
迷子の男の子を探してる人いませんかー！？

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Hiyori! I think I found his mom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーいヒヨリちゃん！　
お母さんらしき人見つけてきたよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
出店のおじさん！

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me!
Is my son really here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
すみません、
息子はどこに……！

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Oh! Mama!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ママだ！

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness you're okay!
You have no idea how worried I was!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった！　
無事だったのね……！　
すっごく心配したんだから！

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごめんなさーい……

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Thanks so, so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん、
お姉ちゃん
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you managed to find her!
text_block_list.orig_text: お母さん見つかってよかったね！

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Thank you as well, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
あと、
お兄さんもありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
You stayed strong right at the end.
Not bad, kid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ……
最後は泣かなかったな。
やるじゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Working with you was real fun!
See you again! Bye-bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへっ！　
お兄さんとおしごとできて、楽しかった！
またね～！　
ばいば〜い！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye!
...He sure took a liking to you, didn't he?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ばいば〜い！
……
あの子が懐いてくれてよかったね！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised how many customers you brought in.
Thanks a lot. You really saved my bacon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客の入りもよくて驚いたよ。
本当に助かった。
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut it! I didn't even do any—
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うるせぇっ！　
俺は別になぁ──

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight
text_block_list.text:
That's enough!
You must be the person who's been causing issues around here recently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──そこまでだ！
おまえか、
この辺りで暴れまわってる男は？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: What's going on?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしたんですか？

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight
text_block_list.text:
There's been several reports of someone trying to start fights
ever since New Year's, so we came out on patrol. Lo and behold,
the culprit's now being violent towards a young girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
新年からやたらと周りにからむヤツが街にいると通報があったので
巡回に来てみたが、
女性に乱暴を働くとは……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
No he's not!
In fact, he just helped us reunite a lost child and his mom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誤解ですっ！　
この人はさっきまで一緒に、
迷子の男の子の、
お母さんを探してくれたんです！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
What's more, he even made takoyaki while the owner was gone!
I'm not lying! I swear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも
このお店のおじさんがいない間、
たこ焼きまで作ってたんです！　
嘘じゃありません！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
It's as she says, sir.
He helped both my store and that lost boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃんの言う通りだ、
騎士さん。
この人はウチの店も、
迷子の子も助けてくれたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight
text_block_list.text:
...Well. No one got hurt, nor is there proof of any scuffle taking place.
Your behavior remains an issue, however.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふむ、
確かにけが人もいないし暴れた形跡もないようだ。
だが、貴様の素行がよくない事実は変わらないからな。

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight
text_block_list.text:
Cause any more issues, and you'll be arrested on the spot.
Now then. Allow us to take our leave.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かあればすぐに捕縛するぞ。
……それでは、
失礼します。

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
Dammit.
The kid's gone home, so I'mma scram too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ……
ガキはもう帰ったし、
俺も帰るぜ。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute!
You made this takoyaki, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待って！　
このたこ焼き、
君が作ったんだろう？

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And so what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
そうだけど……

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious! I actually run a restaurant here, you see.
And now I'm very keen on having you as part of the kitchen staff.
How about it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごくおいしいよ！　
うちの店は普段料理店をやっていてね。
よかったら、
今度は厨房を手伝ってほしいんだが……
どうだろう？

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text: Y-you what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は、
はぁ？

text_block_list.name: Boorish Man
text_block_list.text:
...Well. If I feel like it, I guess.
Catch you later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
まぁ、
気が向いたら……
な。
あばよ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
He might act like that, but I knew he wasn't bad at heart.
No one is, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さん……
やっぱり、
心の底から悪い人なんていないよね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I just hope today stays with him, though.
Maybe that'll help him change, even if just a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日のことで、
お兄さんの心の中が、
すこしでも変わってくれたらうれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Definitely!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよね！　
きっと！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Glad you agree!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士くんもそう思うよね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I mean, just look at what happened today!
Lots of stuff happened, and he helped make a difference!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
今日だけでお兄さんの周りの、
いろんなことが変わったし、
変えられたんだから！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That boy was able to find his mom,
and the stall owner found someone to help with his restaurant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
迷子の男の子はお母さんと会えたし、
出店のおじさんはお店を手伝ってくれそうな人を見つけたしさ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So yeah. He's needed, just like anyone else.
Not only today, but from here on out as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さんは、
みんなに必要な人なんだよ……
今日だけじゃなくて、
これからも！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I always go on about scratching each other's backs,
but today really proved that! Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり困った時は
お互いさまさま、
だよね！
騎士くん！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hiyori flashes a smile at {0}
, happy to have witnessed a moment that allows someone to change for the better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人の心の何かが変わる瞬間を目にしたヒヨリは、
満足げに{0}を見て微笑むのだった。
